outcome: Deliver a deterministic Harness v6.0 release candidate that generates and enforces an extensible Python API plus React frontend architecture, an authoritative project truth index, safe project bootstrapping, and release-grade technical and user documentation.
acceptance_criteria: The immutable v5.0 archive and directory remain unchanged and the source archive SHA-256 is recorded.
A new agent-runtime-v6.0 candidate defines Python API and React frontend boundaries, minimum required directories, allowed architectural extension rules, and thin composition entrypoints.
Requests to centralize application behavior in App.jsx, App.tsx, main.py, or server.py are rejected constructively and valid thin entrypoints remain allowed.
A packaged python-react-hybrid project template and bounded plan/apply bootstrap create missing structure without silently overwriting existing project files.
SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md acts as the authoritative index of project facts and detailed sources without replacing tasks, decisions, tests, schemas, or specialist documentation.
Technical documentation and a user manual are maintained by documented impact triggers and become blocking, complete release artifacts for official project versions.
Architecture, documentation, task, prompt, script, schema, fixture, manifest, SBOM, provenance, migration, and package metadata are internally consistent.

Positive and negative tests cover minimum topology, permitted extensions, import direction, anti-monolith behavior, bootstrap collisions, truth-index integrity, and release-documentation completeness.
All applicable gates close without unresolved blocker and a fresh extracted archive passes strict validation with a recorded SHA-256.

in: Create root managed-task evidence for the v6 evolution.
Derive a new agent-runtime-v6.0 candidate from the immutable v5.0 baseline.
Add normative architecture, memory, documentation, prompts, project template, bootstrap, schemas, validation, tests, migration, and release evidence.
Run bounded local validation and deterministic packaging against synthetic fixtures.
out: Create or change a real downstream product application.
Install dependencies from the network, deploy, commit, push, message, or mutate production.
Execute adversarial traffic or project-owned downstream commands.

triggers: The release changes defaults and refusal behavior for future code generation.
The release introduces filesystem bootstrap behavior and machine release blockers.
Architecture and documentation drift could create false assurance across models and tool hosts.

scope: Root docs/ai/tasks evidence for this v6 task.
A new agent-runtime-v6.0 candidate directory and its deterministic local ZIP.
Bounded temporary validation artifacts without sensitive data.

do_not_touch: all earlier released versions and archives
discover: Inspect only v5 packaging, validation, memory, skills, prompts, schemas, fixtures, and release documentation needed for the successor.
Use current official references only if a changing runtime or framework claim is added.

gates.reason: The release changes project topology, dependency direction, bootstrap and documentation ownership.
gates.approval_ref: workspace owner approval in current task

gates.reason: The architecture introduces an HTTP trust boundary and a filesystem bootstrap tool.
The mandatory React layer and release user manual directly govern user-facing delivery.
Frontend/backend integration and new JSON contracts cross runtime boundaries.
The Harness changes model generation and refusal behavior across hosts.
Generated projects use two runtimes and need bounded build, deployment, and operational guidance.
New bootstrap and static validators require regression and negative-fixture coverage.
A new major archive needs migration, deterministic packaging, rollback and clean-extraction evidence.

approvals.action: Create a new local v6.0 candidate implementing the approved hybrid architecture, truth index, bootstrap, and documentation lifecycle.
approvals.reason: The workspace owner approved the revised plan and authorized creation.
scope: Local reversible candidate and evidence only.
No production, deployment, messaging, commit, push, credential, or external target action.

assumptions: FastAPI plus React with TypeScript and Vite is the default generated profile; Flask remains compatible when it preserves the same boundaries.
Minimum directories are required, additional directories are allowed when their responsibility and dependency direction are documented.
SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md is the root index of authoritative project facts and pointers, not a replacement for detailed evidence.
Official release documentation is blocking while micro changes may declare no documentation impact with a reason.

documentation_impact.reason: The release changes architecture, generation, installation, operations, and downstream user-facing documentation requirements.

manual_checks: Confirm v5.0 immutability and source hash.
Review refusal language, entrypoint exceptions, extension rules, truth precedence, documentation coverage, and packaged file inventory.
Verify archive paths, resource bounds, manifest, SBOM, provenance, deterministic rebuild, and fresh extraction.
evidence: Workspace owner explicitly authorized a third correction and validation round after the default two-round limit.
Bundled strict validation passed 127 checks; the full runner passed with exit code 0; all 34 runtime tests passed with one optional jsonschema-dependent case skipped.
Release security, UI-policy, architecture, documentation, and passive loopback adversarial-plan checks returned exit code 0.
Two deterministic package plans matched; the final 168-file archive passed path, resource, manifest, SBOM, provenance, timestamp, and fresh-extraction validation.

not_validated.area: Target model and host behavior execution
not_validated.reason: The 27-case behavioral suite is pinned and structurally validated but was not executed on every intended model and host.
No downstream application or paid deployment is in scope, so quotas and worst-case exposure remain project-specific.

next_action: Publish the archive digest through a trusted channel and execute the pinned behavior suite on each intended model and host before broad rollout.
